question: GQ-006
subject: closing out the launchd survey — every failing job now classified

the_exception_resolved.why_it_looked_different: Its program is /opt/homebrew/bin/node, which exists — so my "missing program" test passed it.
the_exception_resolved.actual_cause: WorkingDirectory is ~/foundry-interface and that directory DOES NOT EXIST. launchd fails with EX_CONFIG before running anything, which is why /tmp/foundry-interface.err is empty. The command arguments are relative paths (node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs, server.ts) that only resolve inside it.
the_exception_resolved.verdict: Same defect after all — a deleted path, just the working directory rather than the program. So exit-78 is 15 of 15, not 14 of 15.

remaining_ten.reading: These are genuinely different: the program exists and the job runs and then fails. foundry-momentum is the one I already traced — its program runs fine and dies on an empty source database. The other nine are real runtime failures, not deleted files.

malformed_plist.finding: Its plist is not well-formed XML (ExpatError at line 9). Found because it crashed my survey loop mid-scan.
malformed_plist.lesson: One malformed file terminated the scan and would have hidden the six jobs after it. Guarded, then re-run.

final_classification.note: 26 = 11 exit-127 + 15 exit-78, every one pointing at a path that no longer exists.
